\paragraph{Validation.} Peak current scales \(4.07\times\) between
\SI{25}{\milli\volt\per\second} and \SI{400}{\milli\volt\per\second} against the
\(4.00\times\) of the \(\sqrt{v}\) law, and reads high against
Randles--\v{S}ev\v{c}\'ik by \SIrange{0.08}{1.86}{\percent} over that range
(Table~\ref{tab:electrode-peaks}). The kinetic parameter moves the model along
the Matsuda--Ayabe progression as it should: at
\SI{50}{\milli\volt\per\second}, \(k^0 = \SI{0.1}{\centi\metre\per\second}\)
gives \(\Lambda = 18.1\) and a reversible response
(\(\Delta E_p = \SI{60.0}{\milli\volt}\), \(i_p\) within
\SI{0.11}{\percent}), while \(k^0 = \SI{1e-3}{\centi\metre\per\second}\) gives
\(\Lambda = 0.181\), \(\Delta E_p = \SI{167}{\milli\volt}\) and \(i_p\)
\SI{15.5}{\percent} low --- the quasi-reversible regime a sluggish carbon
electrode occupies.

Discretisation is the accuracy limit, not the transient solver. Eight slabs per
species is unusable (\(i_p\) high by \SI{232}{\percent}); 16 slabs and above
agree within \SI{0.35}{\percent} of each other, and 28 is what the model ships.
Reducing the maximum time step from
\SI{20}{\milli\second} to \SI{0.5}{\milli\second} changes \(i_p\) by less than
the fourth significant figure while multiplying the point count by 40. Roughly
\num{60} sweeps ran without a single convergence failure at
\texttt{errpreset=conservative}, and the exponential terms survive an
overpotential sweep to \(\pm\SI{12}{\volt}\) with and without the exponent clamp;
the clamp and the shunt conductance of Table~\ref{tab:electrode-params} are
insurance, not a requirement of this fixture.

One design limit falls out of the same runs. At \SI{50}{\milli\volt\per\second}
on \SI{1}{\square\milli\metre}, double-layer charging is \SI{0.74}{\percent} of
the peak at \SI{1}{\milli\mole\per\litre} but \SI{37}{\percent} of a
\SI{27}{\nano\ampere} peak at \SI{0.02}{\milli\mole\per\litre}: below roughly
\SI{0.1}{\milli\mole\per\litre} the faradaic peak is buried in the charging
current rather than in the front end's noise floor, and the remedy is a slower
scan, not more gain.
